title: E0129: Command execution via shell_exec
plain_english: Passing untrusted input to `shell_exec()` can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary shell commands on the server.
why_matters: Command injection through `shell_exec()` can: - Run arbitrary system commands - Read or modify files and databases - Install malware or backdoors - Lead to full server compromise
what_it_checks: `shell_exec()` calls where the command string contains tainted input
`shell_exec()` calls with user-controlled command arguments without escaping
